name: ens_internal_test_v1
purpose: Single confirmatory evaluation of the frozen ENS on the causal internal SIL/HIL test. No model change after this run.
test_population: causal_input_v1 test via CausalCacheDataset(split='test', purpose='evaluation'): 34802 supervised windows, 553 cases; excluded windows reported but not scored

models.GBT: 130 window statistics, HistGradientBoosting max_iter 400, lr 0.05, max_leaf_nodes 31, l2 1.0, random_state 0, M0-equivalent Balanced weights, fit once on full source train 162069; fit before reading test
models.ENS: mean of M0 and GBT fault probabilities, fault if >= 0.5
models.M0_rule: argmax (fault if p1 > p0), as in all M0 reports

pass_rule.b: fault TP >= M0 TP - 0.5% of test fault windows
pass_rule.c: independent-normal hover >30 s FP lower than M0
pass_rule.d: per-class fault recall drop <= 1.0 pp for each of six classes, on windows outside hover >30 s
pass_rule.e: report hover >30 s GPS and barometer recall, SIL/HIL split, per-flight-status independent-normal FP; no threshold
pass_rule.case_level: report case-level independent-normal false-alarm rate (case with any FP window) and fault-case detection (case with any TP window) for both models; no threshold

verdict: PASS if a-d hold. Result is final for the internal test; failures are reported, not retried.
forbidden: any re-fit, re-threshold, re-fusion or second test evaluation
